label: Entertainment
definition: Narrative-first content meant to amuse, engage, or emotionally hook. Includes skits, dramas, pop culture, celebrity content.

label: Movies & TV
definition: Narrative content about scripted entertainment — includes reviews, recaps, breakdowns, and lore analysis.

label: Film
definition: Films and filmmaking from the audience side: critique, analysis, and discussion of story, craft, and cultural impact.
scope_note: Excludes television series (01.01.002) and nature or space storytelling (13.41.083).

label: Blockbuster Films
definition: Covers major studio films, franchises, and tentpole releases, including their story, spectacle, and cultural impact.
example_concepts: Action Movie Review;Post-Trailer Reaction;Franchise Box Office Analysis;Ranking Every Superhero Sequel;Why Sequels Feel Safer Now

label: Independent Film
definition: Covers independent and arthouse cinema, including its narrative themes and artistic style.
example_concepts: Indie Film Ending Explained;Top 5 Indie Films;Festival Breakout Film Review;Rise of Micro-Budget Horror;Indie Director Visual Style

label: Television
definition: Scripted television series: episodes, arcs, characters, and the conversation around them.
scope_note: Excludes film (01.01.001).

label: Currently Airing Series
definition: Covers scripted series during their broadcast run, followed episode by episode as new installments release.
example_concepts: Latest Episode Recap;Midseason Twist Fan Reaction;Key Moments Episode Breakdown;Weekly Episode Discussion Podcast;Cliffhanger Hot Takes;Watch Party Night Vlog

label: Season Arcs & Finales
definition: Highlights seasonal arcs or finales with emphasis on narrative payoff or fan impact.
example_concepts: Season's Best Scenes;Fan-Made Season Montage;Finale Narrative Payoff Analysis;Ranking Every Season Finale;Series Finale Live Reaction;Why Final Seasons Disappoint

label: Comedy
definition: Humor-forward content designed to entertain through skits, satire, parody, improv, or stand-up.

label: Sketch & Improv Comedy
definition: Scripted sketches and improvised scenes performed for laughs.
scope_note: Excludes pretend play made for kids (01.67.161). Parody of a specific genre keeps that genre's path with Format 67 Parody.

label: Scripted Sketches
definition: Covers scripted comedy sketches written and performed as self-contained scenes.
example_concepts: Quick Comedy Sketch;Parody Commercial Sketch;Cast Reacts to Old Sketches;Sketch Writing Room Footage;Best Sketches of the Year

label: Improv Scenes
definition: Improvised comedy content featuring spontaneous dialogue and unpredictable scenarios.
example_concepts: Improv Night Recording;Improv Rehearsal Footage;Improv Skit Challenge;Best Improv Scene Moments;Improv Show Highlights

label: Stand-Up
definition: Solo comedic performances delivered to a live or virtual audience, often observational or narrative in tone.

label: Club & Open Mic Sets
definition: Covers stand-up sets performed at comedy clubs, open mics, and touring shows outside of produced specials.
example_concepts: Comedy Club Performance Set;Stand-Up Rant on Trends;Best Crowd Work Moments;Green Room Before Open Mic;Comedian Road Gig Vlog;Roasting the Front Row

label: Comedy Specials
definition: Long-form recorded comedy specials with structured pacing and audience engagement.
example_concepts: Comedy Special Review;Behind-the-Special Audio Chat;Best Specials of the Decade;Special's Best Bits;Controversial Special Hot Take;Roast Special Highlights

label: Music & Performance
definition: Live or recorded expression through music, dance, acting, or talent-based performance.

label: Music Releases
definition: Recorded music and its visual releases: singles, music videos, and independent audio-visual work.
scope_note: Excludes how music is written or produced (06.18) and live concerts (01.03.006).

label: Pop Releases
definition: Showcases professionally released music content for mainstream distribution.
example_concepts: Pop Hits Montage;New Pop Single Reveal;Official Pop Music Video;First Listen Album Reaction;Pop Album Review

label: Indie & Experimental Music

example_concepts: Indie Artist Video Showcase;Home-Made Indie Music Video;Experimental Audio-Visual Piece;Bedroom Studio Recording Process;Underground Album Review

label: Concerts & Stage Performance
definition: Music, theater, dance, or busking performed before an audience, at venues or in public spaces.
scope_note: Excludes kids' songs (01.67.159) and worship services (16.51.113).

label: Concerts & Festivals
definition: Covers concerts, music festivals, and ticketed live music events.
example_concepts: Full Festival Set Recording;Concert Highlight Moments;Festival Weekend Vlog;Front Row Fancam;Arena Tour Concert Review

label: Street Shows
definition: Street-level performances including dance, theater, or busking recorded in public spaces.
example_concepts: Street Gig Recording;Busking Day Video Diary;Best Street Performers Compilation;Setting Up a Busking Pitch

label: Kids & Family
definition: Genres made for children that have no adult equivalent: kids' songs, toy play, and kids' animation.

label: Nursery Rhymes & Kids' Songs
definition: Songs, rhymes, and music made for young children, usually animated or performed for sing-along.

label: Nursery Rhymes & Sing-Alongs
definition: Classic and original nursery rhymes and sing-along songs.
example_concepts: One Hour Nursery Rhyme Mix;Animated Classic Rhyme;Sing-Along with Lyrics

label: Dance & Movement Songs

label: Toy Play & Unboxing
definition: Toys opened, played with, and used to tell stories, made for a child audience.

label: New Toys & Collectibles

example_concepts: Giant Surprise Egg Opening;First Play with New Playset;Toy Store Shopping Haul;Kid Rates New Toy;Collectible Figure Set Showcase

label: Pretend Play & Toy Stories
definition: Stories acted out with toys, dolls, and playsets.
example_concepts: Doll Family Bedtime Story;Toy Cars Rescue Mission;Pretend Play Episodes Marathon

label: Kids' Animation & Characters
definition: Animated series, recurring characters, and story content made for children.

definition: Episodic animated shows and character channels for children.
example_concepts: Full Season Episode Compilation;Character Adventure Episode;Character Short Comedy Bit;New Season Trailer

example_concepts: Picture Book Read-Aloud;Sleepy Forest Bedtime Tale;Whispered Calm Bedtime Story;One Hour Bedtime Stories

label: Competitions & Spectacle
definition: Large-scale creator competitions, stunts, and giveaway spectacles built around stakes and elimination.

label: Creator Competitions
definition: Contests among participants for a prize: last-to-leave games, elimination games, and team challenges.

label: Elimination Games
definition: Participants are knocked out round by round until one wins the prize.
example_concepts: Last Team Standing Wins;Final Round Elimination Moments;Every Elimination Recapped;Building the Elimination Arena

label: Stunts & Giveaways
definition: Large-budget stunts, builds, and giveaways staged for spectacle.

label: Extreme Stunts
definition: Dangerous, extreme, or record-setting stunts and builds performed for an audience.
example_concepts: World's Largest Domino Run;Testing a Bulletproof Car;Building the Giant Ramp;Car Versus Hydraulic Press

label: Giveaway & Philanthropy Spectacles
definition: Large giveaways and staged acts of generosity built as entertainment.
example_concepts: Last to Leave Wins the House;Surprising Strangers with Cars;Rebuilding a Family Home;Funding Wells for Villages;Planning a Massive Giveaway

label: Education
definition: Purpose is to teach, explain, or transfer skills. Includes tutorials, explainers, language learning, academic breakdowns.

label: Academic
definition: Formal subject matter rooted in school or university disciplines — often structured and instructional.

label: Math Lessons
definition: Teaches math concepts or problem-solving using clear, step-by-step visual instruction.

label: Algebra
definition: Covers algebraic concepts and problem-solving, from equations and variables to functions.
example_concepts: Solving Equations Step-by-Step;Why Algebra Matters;Factoring Shortcut Trick;Homework Problems Solve-Along

label: Calculus
definition: Covers calculus principles such as limits, derivatives, and integrals.
example_concepts: Intro to Derivatives Guide;Student Calculus Questions Answered;Integrals Explained Visually;Chain Rule Practice Problems

label: History Lessons
definition: Explains historical events, timelines, figures, or cultural eras through narrative or analysis.
scope_note: Excludes military history (05.15.104) and historical conspiracies (05.15.091).

label: Ancient Civilizations
definition: Covers ancient civilizations, from early societies through late antiquity, through artifacts and analysis.
example_concepts: Ancient Egypt Storytime;Timeline of Early Societies;Lost City Excavation;Fall of the Roman Empire

label: Modern History

label: Preschool Learning
definition: Early-learning content teaching letters, numbers, colors, shapes, and first words.

label: ABCs & Counting
definition: Alphabet, phonics, and counting lessons for preschoolers.
example_concepts: Letter Sounds for Preschoolers;Learn to Count to Ten;Trace the Alphabet Together;Phonics Lessons Compilation;Animated ABC Song

label: Colors, Shapes & First Words
definition: Early vocabulary, colors, and shapes taught through repetition and play.
example_concepts: First Words Learning Compilation;Shapes All Around Us;Name the Color Game

label: Skills & DIY
definition: Instructional content teaching practical, hands-on tasks like repairs, crafts, or creative builds.

label: Coding & Programming
definition: Learning to code: building, testing, and deploying software, taught step by step.

label: Web Development
definition: Teaches how to build websites through HTML, CSS, and JavaScript foundations.
example_concepts: HTML Basics Tutorial;Website Build Walkthrough;Code-Along Portfolio Site;CSS Layout Quick Tips;Frontend Frameworks Compared

label: Sewing
definition: Covers sewing construction, stitching techniques, and fabric selection for garments and household items.
example_concepts: Dressmaking Starter Guide;Seam Allowance Tips;Sewing a Zipper Tutorial;DIY Tote Bag;Thrifted Dress Alteration;Fabric Store Haul

label: Science & Discovery
definition: Content exploring physical, natural, or theoretical phenomena with curiosity and explanation.
scope_note: Classroom-style science teaching for learners. Excludes research, discoveries, and science news (Sector 13).

label: Space Exploration
definition: Explores human and robotic exploration of space, astronomy, or rocketry.

label: Planets & Moons

label: Ecosystems & Habitats

example_concepts: Rainforest Ecosystem Breakdown;Coral Reef Recovery Case Study;Life in a Wetland;How Food Webs Work;Tide Pool Life Up Close

label: Language Learning

definition: Structured instruction in a language, from first words to grammar and vocabulary.
